secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for AI features. Get it from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com) → Get API Key. A dev placeholder is set so the app boots; replace with a real key to enable AI features.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key for checkout. Leave empty for lead-only capture. Get from Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API keys.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret for checkout webhooks. Get from Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks.

secrets.name: STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe publishable key for client-side checkout. Get from Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API keys.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key for webinar email notifications. Get from Resend Dashboard → API Keys.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL for auth. Get from Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon key for client-side auth. Get from Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL for server-side authentication. Get from Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon key for server-side token verification. Get from Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key for server-side operations. Get from Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API.

secrets.name: EMAIL_FROM
secrets.description: Verified Resend sender identity, for example Infinite Masterpiece <hello@your-domain.co.il>.
